objective: Test whether selecting the independently proven c1-exact and c2-exact GDN norm arithmetic from live request metadata repairs output identity at both concurrencies.

treatment.selector_boundary: Inside the opaque qwen_gdn_row_stable_rmsnorm_gated_xpu custom-op implementation, where get_forward_context() exposes live GDNAttentionMetadata and cannot be frozen by the enclosing compiled graph.
treatment.single_request_arm: R99: eight-row reduction, num_warps=2, num_stages=1; 1024-element pointwise, num_warps=4, num_stages=1; libdevice rsqrt/exp.
treatment.multi_request_arm: R97: one-row reduction, num_warps=2, default pipeline stages; 256-element pointwise, num_warps=4, default pipeline stages; Triton rsqrt/exp.
treatment.request_count: max(num_prefills, num_decodes, num_spec_decodes) from the live layer GDNAttentionMetadata; select the multi-request arm only when this is greater than one.
unchanged: frozen prompts, token oracle, request order, and cache-disabled request flags

fixed_workload.sequence: Run cache-c000 alone at c1, then cache-c000 plus index-c001 at c2 on one fresh server and empty compile cache.

followup_if_pass: Build a non-tracing image, extend warmup for both arms, repeat the frozen gate, then perform clean-boot varied realistic prompts and determinism qualification before any performance promotion.
followup_if_fail: Preserve the result and identify whether prefill or speculative decode requires a different live selector; do not substitute fixture row-count heuristics.
promotion_boundary: Diagnostic only. No public speed or quality authority; the current boot contains an earlier GPU reset.
